view: Frontal chest radiograph (likely AP; scapulae partially projected over the upper lateral lung fields, superior mediastinum appears wide). "L" side marker and technologist initials at the patient's upper left (image top-right) confirm conventional orientation.
technical_quality: Adequate but suboptimal: low lung volumes (approximately 8 posterior ribs, hemidiaphragms high), slight underpenetration (thoracic spine only faintly seen through the heart), minimal rotation (clavicles roughly symmetric about the spinous processes). Large body habitus with abundant chest-wall soft tissue adding density to both lower zones.

devices.type: External side marker 'L' with technologist initials (no medical device)
devices.location: Patient's left upper corner of the film (image top-right), outside the thorax

abnormalities.finding: Enlarged cardiac silhouette (cardiothoracic ratio roughly 0.5-0.55; transverse diameter approx. 16 cm) - cardiomegaly, partly exaggerated by AP projection and shallow inspiration

Prominent, ill-defined bilateral hila with increased perihilar and lower-zone interstitial/vascular markings and upper-zone vessel prominence - pulmonary vascular congestion / mild interstitial edema pattern
Widened superior mediastinum with prominent aortic knob - likely projection/tortuous aorta and vascular engorgement rather than a mass; not definitively assessable on this film
Elevated right hemidiaphragm with a smooth dome, higher than the left
Blunting of the right costophrenic angle with lateral peaking of the right diaphragm contour - small right pleural effusion (possibly subpulmonic) suspected
Left costophrenic angle largely preserved; only equivocal minimal blunting, partly obscured by chest-wall soft tissue
Low lung volumes / shallow inspiration crowding the basal vessels
No focal consolidation, mass, pneumothorax, or cavity; trachea midline; bones intact without acute fracture; no lines, tubes, pacemaker, or surgical clips

description_zh: 正面胸部X光（疑為AP投照），吸氣不足、肩胛骨部分重疊於肺野，穿透度略低。心影增大（心胸比約0.5以上），上縱膈增寬、主動脈結突出；雙側肺門影增粗且邊界模糊，雙側肺門周圍及下肺野血管與間質紋理增加，符合肺血管充血／輕度間質性肺水腫表現。右側橫膈抬高、右側肋膈角變鈍，疑有少量右側肋膜積液；左側肋膈角大致清晰。未見局部實質化、氣胸或腫塊，骨骼無急性病變，未見任何管路、引流管或植入裝置。
